fact_text: Pakistan's household gas tariff uses 12 consumption slabs, so light users pay less and heavy users pay more; the subsidy is delivered through these slabs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The policy direction under discussion is to replace across-the-board tariff subsidies for power and gas with direct cash transfers to poor households via the Benazir Income Support Programme, phased in gradually.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Privatising power distribution companies works by prequalifying bidders who may acquire 51 to 100% ownership, sharing detailed documents with them, and then having one qualified buyer complete the share purchase.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under new FBR rules, live cattle, sheep and goats can be imported duty and tax free for fattening, then either re-exported live or slaughtered and exported as halal meat; animals raised in Pakistan are excluded.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The livestock import scheme waives customs duty, additional customs duty, regulatory duty, sales tax, federal excise duty and withholding income tax, but only if every required obligation is met.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Animal feed, veterinary medicines, vaccines, supplements, disinfectants and animal identification devices also receive duty and tax relief, separate from the live-animal import track.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Brazil, India and the United States are large halal meat exporters to Muslim countries despite not being Muslim-majority, which the analyst cites as evidence Pakistan could rank among the top five halal meat exporters.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Punjab's vehicle certification exempts cars up to 5 years old below 1000cc, up to 6 years old at 1001-2000cc and up to 7 years old above 2000cc; older vehicles need a certificate valid for one year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The WTO raised its global merchandise trade volume growth forecast for 2026 to 3.9%, up from 1.9% before the US-Iran conflict, and for 2027 to 4.1%, up from 2.6%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's sea freight transport service exports rose 73% year on year in the first half of 2026, as Middle East transport traffic shifted to Pakistani operators during the conflict.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A Middle East conflict that disrupts shipping routes and lifts fuel prices weighs on global market sentiment, including the PSX, while the same disruption can divert freight to Pakistani transport operators.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: During COVID-19, when much of the world largely shut down, Pakistan's IT sector boomed, showing that a crisis favours businesses that can deliver remotely and that the gain depends on how well a country uses it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The PSX reacts day to day to Middle East headlines in both directions, such as airport strikes, territorial recaptures and US-Iran strike threats, so headline-driven weeks tend to close mixed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Spotify launched globally in 2008 but reached Pakistan only in 2021, illustrating how global digital services can arrive late in Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan’s Opportunity Amid Middle East Tensions? | IMF Update & Shafy Weekly Roundup' (YouTube transcript, undated)
